temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. Gary declines Ethan's invitation to a weekend retreat because he has too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated, hardworking friend, but had not yet fully recognized the seriousness of Gary's work habits or their impact on his health.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan's concern becomes more specific: Gary's dedication is harming his health, and Gary is unwilling or unable to step away because of hospital demands.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overworking to an unhealthy degree and may be unable or unwilling to take a break because of hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and worried; perhaps frustrated by Gary's refusal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Intervene by urging Gary to attend the retreat and prioritize his health, while offering support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. Gary admits that things are complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary's overwork was mainly due to hospital obligations and that a retreat might help him relax.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan's suspicion that something deeper is going on is confirmed and strengthened.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is tied to complicated issues beyond ordinary professional duties, and Gary is withholding them to avoid burdening others.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and worried; cautiously alert.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Confront Gary nonjudgmentally, reassure him that he can share anything, and encourage him to open up so Ethan can help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Gary accepts Ethan's suggestion to prioritize and delegate tasks and to organize his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary's overwork was complicated and that Gary was hiding personal or professional burdens.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now understands the specific causes and sees that Gary is willing to accept practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork stems from new departmental pressures and personal challenges; with support, delegation, and organization, he can find better balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved and empathetic; compassionate and mildly optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Gary reports improvement, is less overwhelmed, and has had time for leisure like watching a movie. Ethan sees Gary making efforts while still facing challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary needed practical help and was willing to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan sees evidence that the support and Gary's changes are working.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making genuine progress toward balance and is not as overwhelmed, though continued encouragement may still help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular check-ins, discuss challenges, and offer support and encouragement.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and feels more in control. Gary credits Ethan's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was improving but still benefited from encouragement and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now believes Gary can manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthier balance and is capable of maintaining it on his own; active intervention from Ethan is no longer necessary.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Step back from active involvement while letting Gary know he remains available if needed.
